$comment: Browser hostnames. Not passwords. VistaRemote has no apex domain — it is a vistacast.dev subdomain. Brand docs also mention remote.vistacast.dev; put the DNS you actually created here.

products.label: 控制面 / Identity
products.note: 对外 Identity 是 login.luminaryworks.dev；控制台是 console.luminaryworks.dev。清空此栏才走源站 IP:端口。

products.label: VistaRemote
products.note: 没有独立主域名。必须挂在 vistacast.dev 下（本次 DNS：vistaremote.vistacast.dev）。不要写成 vistaremote.dev。品牌文档里的官网是 remote.vistacast.dev，以你实际解析为准。
